cells.owns: Minimal main calls management.Run with project factory; all web/worker/migrate commands share config.
Typed settings, explicit app list, provider constructors and root route includes; no hidden service locator.
App label, version, dependencies, Register and Ready; references generated model registry.
Go model fields and Schema descriptors; generated typed field/query references are checked in and regenerated deterministically.
Request handlers/resource views, input/output contracts and named app routes; domain service logic can live in services.go.
HTML forms, templates and app-namespaced static assets; optional for API-only app.
Explicit admin model registration and typed task declarations only when respective modules installed.
Immutable historical descriptors and ordered operations registered in generated manifest; compiled into project binary.
Public request/task/schema tests; isolated real PostgreSQL/Redis integration fixtures.
Grouped identical setting names, safe defaults only; .env ignored. Credentials empty and required when capability selected.
Install released Core and generator. Versions are placeholders for future published releases, not packages available now.
Install only selected modules, register constructor explicitly; installation alone never activates runtime behavior.
One central Go entrypoint in development; gogo build emits a production manage executable with the same commands.
cells.path: go run manage.go makemigrations; migrate; runserver; worker; beat
